title: Nvidia, Lucid Build Uber AI Fleet—Not Tesla? - Lucid Group (NASDAQ:LCID), NVIDIA (NASDAQ:NVDA), Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA), Uber Technologies (NYSE:UBER)
summary: Nvidia and Lucid are developing autonomous systems and vehicles with Uber, challenging Tesla's full-stack control model. Nvidia is expanding into full-stack AI platforms, while Lucid focuses on efficient hardware and autonomy-ready vehicles. Uber's global demand positions it as the distribution engine for these systems, potentially leading a modular, scalable ecosystem in autonomous vehicles.
sentiment_reason: The article presents a shift in the autonomous vehicle market with the emergence of a modular ecosystem, which could lead to competition based on system efficiency rather than vehicle control, indicating negative sentiment due to the potential disruption of Tesla's established strategy.
